articles.detail: 5 cycles, 5 completed; cycle commits record 10/10/11/15/11 (67 yesterday); 1 quarantined

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active and no pause gate is set, but the baseline moved again: commit c23e3054 (19:24 UTC today) added a sixth feed query (Q6, tracked-series headlines) to fetch-news-api.js and edited select-prompt.md and write-prompt.md, on top of the 09-29 sonnet-5-5 swap and the 09-30 prompt audit. Only the 22:00 cycle ran on it, so a feed or selector experiment started now would be confounded; the earliest clean start is about 2026-10-04.
weakestArea: Latin America is furthest from target at 2% against 5%: one dateline (La Paz) in 53 articles, down from 4% yesterday. US datelines are 26% against 25% and multi-source is 28% against 30% (15 of 53), both narrow misses. The 2026-09-18 GAP_COUNTRIES experiment added Mexico and Argentina and produced no datelines from either, so that lever should not be repeated as designed.
watching: Gulf build-up: a third US carrier and 10,000 troops are reported for the Middle East, sourced only from state or advocacy outlets, while Putin renewed an offer to take Iran's enriched uranium and Iran denied a Rubio expulsion claim.
Russia and Ukraine: Putin rejected a strike truce, and Ukraine fielded swimming robots at Kostiantynivka.
Horn of Africa: drones hit Addis Ababa.
Pakistan and Afghanistan: Rawalpindi issued a warning to Kabul, and LPG prices rose in Pakistan.
India and the US: the trade deal stalled and a Modi-Trump call covered Russian oil; the call story is state-or-advocacy-only.
Venezuela: BP and Shell are entering oil and gas after the Maduro seizure, also state-or-advocacy-only.
South China Sea: Manila confronted a Chinese survey ship.
AI and tech: Google is holding back Gemini 4 Argon, a judge dismissed AI suits against Google, and a Pentagon breach exposed troop data.
coverageGaps: Latin America has one dateline (La Paz) and Oceania has none, so the region count fell from 6 to 5.
Africa fell to 3 (Abuja, Addis Ababa, Johannesburg) from 6 yesterday and 15 on 09-29.

Science is 6, above the floor of 5, but two of its datelines are countries (China, South Korea) and one is a US test site, and its sources include Aol and The War Zone rather than dedicated science outlets.
Country-level datelines dropped from eight to two (China, South Korea); missingDateline still does not count them.
The Regeni pair from 09-29 is still live (regeni-italy-convicts-egyptian-agents and regeni-egyptian-officers-sentenced-rome); one should be removed, and sameEventDuplicates does not catch it.
Freshness was measured on 4 of 53 articles, so the median of 0 says little.
context: All five cycles completed at an average of 873s (selector 229s, writer 143s, editor 59s). The new Q6 query spends one more NewsAPI token per cycle; it is an operator change, and the 22:00 log shows it returning 100 items without a 429. Tech held at 15 and sci+tech rose to 40% as politics and economy fell with total volume (53 from 67). One article was quarantined by the validator, against none yesterday.
